race.comment: CARDONETTE (11) is a progressive mare who should be at her top now fourth-up. Thompson was perhaps too cute with her here two weeks ago when running out of time. Doubt he makes the same mistake again. MILLENNIUM BLADE (5) made a solid stable debut here earlier this month and is sure to have come on from that. If he gets back to his Vic best, he's in this up to his ears. IL FRATELLO (10) is making progress, scoring a second-up win last start. This is harder but he looks to have more to offer. DAIANE (16) has gone back-to-back with dominant all-the-way wins. Is a chance to steal it if she gets it all her own way.
